phase_prompt.label: The Victim Runtime
phase_prompt.summary: The Red Bull-Calf stands as a solitary figure of warmth in a cold system, awaiting its inevitable deletion. It is a study in texture, light, and the tragedy of short-lived existence.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, medium shot of a Red Bull-Calf, its coat a vibrant, earthy red, standing nervously in a vast, darker environment. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, highlighting the curve of its neck and the fear in its dark, reflective eyes. The background is a blurred, industrial-abstract void suggesting a system boundary. The calf looks physically tangible, heavy, and soft, contrasting with the sharp, digital nature of the world it inhabits.
